title: Number of Vacant Rental Flats in Woodlands and Nationwide
what_it_is: Number of Vacant Rental Flats in Woodlands and Nationwide

sections.label: Vacant flats sprucing backlog
sections.summary: About half of vacant flats are unavailable to new applicants, and sprucing works for the rest are delayed by COVID-19 manpower shortages, with HDB aiming to clear the backlog by the third quarter.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: About half of these are not available for new applicants as they are in blocks that are due for redevelopment or are reserved to house existing tenants of flats that are affected by redevelopment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The other half are available to new applicants, of which two-thirds need to be spruced up before they can be let out.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In Woodlands, there are 320 vacant flats available to new applicants, and about 220 of them need to be spruced up before they can be let out.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For vacant flats that need to be spruced up, the pace of sprucing works has been adversely affected by manpower shortages in the construction industry during this COVID-19 period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB is monitoring the situation closely and aims to clear the backlog of flats that need to be spruced up by the third quarter of this year.

sections.label: Rental flat supply and demand
sections.summary: The reply states the wait is less than a year and that there are enough rental flats to meet demand.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We shared in the reply in January that it is less than a year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And for the supply of rental flats, we have enough rental flats to meet the demand and we will continue to watch this carefully.

sections.label: Assurance on rental flat sprucing
sections.summary: With additional resources, manpower and contractors, the sprucing up is expected to be completed by the third quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, I want to assure Members that we do our best to provide rental flats to all the applicants.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And now, with these additional resources, manpower,  contractors that we have, we are confident that we will be able to do the sprucing up by the third quarter of this year.

sections.label: Question on sprucing timeline
sections.summary: A question asks whether the projection is now more or less than five months, noting a six-month figure quoted in July.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: My question is, is it now projected to be more than five months or less than five months, in view of the evolving manpower situation?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I think what he quoted was actually six months – that was in July.
